paper.title: EgoZero: Robot Learning from Smart Glasses

claim: EgoZero 发现 HaMeR 在相机坐标系下的末端预测不准确，但其手坐标系内的局部预测更可靠；因此用 Aria MPS 的 6DoF 手姿(H_t)校正 HaMeR 构建的掌心坐标系，即把 HaMeR 的局部手部形变与 Aria 的 ego-centric 手部定位组合成最终动作标签。

evidence.summary: 3.1 节明确写出 HaMeR 相机系不准、手系可靠，并以 H_t 校正掌心帧的组合方案(式 1)。
evidence.short_quote: Though HaMeR’s end-effector predictions in camera frame are inaccurate, its pre- dictions localized in hand frame are more reliable. Therefore, we compose local hand deformation from HaMeR with egocentric hand information from Aria.

notes: 本批最贴近'ego-centric 采集端追踪质量边界'的论文：Aria MPS 手姿提供绝对定位、HaMeR 提供手系形变的分工，以及 1-2cm 动作标签误差上限、>5cm 深度误差全失败两组阈值性数字。注意推理端仍用 iPhone 深度，纯眼镜只覆盖采集。

paper_reading.relation: 揭示 ego-centric 采集端手部轨迹的误差结构与缓解：单目手部模型的相机系绝对位姿不可靠，需用 SLAM 级手姿(Aria MPS)提供绝对定位、手部模型仅提供局部形变——检测精度决定各组件的角色分配。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 引文逐字出自 3.1；后续掌心帧构建与式 1 组合链已在全文核对，claim 限定在动作标签生成环节。

paper.title: EgoZero: Robot Learning from Smart Glasses

claim: EgoZero 作者量化承认：Aria 手姿并不总是预测手上同一位置，HaMeR 对手部的旋转与平移分量预测不稳定；即使仔细调整动作组合公式(式 1)，最终动作标签仍含 1-2cm 误差，使策略无法解决高精度任务。

evidence.summary: 4.5 Limitations of hand models 逐句给出 Aria/HaMeR 误差来源与 1-2cm 标签误差及其对高精度任务的阻断。
evidence.short_quote: Aria’s hand pose does not always predict the same location on the hand and [54] predicts inconsistently incorrect rotational and translational components on the hand. Even when carefully Equation 1 is tuned, the action labels contain 1- 2cm error, preventing the policy from solving high-precision tasks.

paper.title: EgoZero: Robot Learning from Smart Glasses

claim: 在 ego-centric 无深度传感器设定下，最优单目度量深度模型即使经场景中多个 Aruco 标签标定仍产生 >5cm 的深度误差，用估计深度替代三角化训练的策略在全部 7 个任务上无一例外地失败(0/15)；EgoZero 因此改用 CoTracker3 追踪+沿相机轨迹三角化来恢复物体 3D 状态。

evidence.summary: 4.3 消融报告 >5cm 深度误差与'All policies trained with estimated depth fail unequivocally'；Table 1 中 EGOZERO - triangulated depth 行 7 任务全 0/15。
evidence.short_quote: We observe that the best metric depth models, even when grounded with many Aruco tags in the scene, produce depth measurements of >5cm error. This suggests that the depth maps are warped unevenly, potentially by the distortion caused by Aria’s fisheye. All policies trained with estimated depth fail unequivocally.

paper.title: EgoZero: Robot Learning from Smart Glasses

claim: 作者综述指出：从单目视觉输入预测手部关键点的手部姿态估计模型(如 HaMeR 一类)虽在简单场景有效，但对遮挡脆弱、时序不一致、且对背景干扰物缺乏鲁棒性。

evidence.summary: Related Work 末段对手部姿态估计模型[54-57]的总体评价；依赖被引工作，属作者综合判断。
evidence.short_quote: These models are trained with imitation learning to predict hand keypoints [58] from monocular visual input. Although effective in many simple domains, these models are brittle to occlusions, temporally inconsistent, and lack robustness to background distractors.
